senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced. wds.) female sex, female; female gender.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:2">Nidd. III, 2</cite>, a. fr. <he>תשב לנ׳</he> she must observe the laws of cleanness for the birth of a female child (<cite ref="Leviticus 12:5">Lev. XII, 5</cite>). Ib. 31ᵇ, v. <cite ref="N01195"><he>נָקִי</he> I</cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>לשון נ׳</he> feminine gender.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:6:5">Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9ᵈ</cite> <he>ממקום נ׳</he>, v. next w.—Pl. <cite ref="N01160"><he>נְקֵבוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="N01159"><he>נְקֵי׳</he></cite>.
